antonym.description: Given an English word, give a word with the opposite meaning.

synonym.description: Given an English word, give a different word with the same meaning.

singular-plural.description: Given an English noun in the singular, give its plural form.

present-past.description: Given an English verb in its base form, give its past tense form.

country-capital.description: Given the name of a country, give the name of its capital city.

country-currency.description: Given the name of a country, give the name of the currency used there.

landmark-country.description: Given the name of a landmark, place, building or institution, give the country where it is located.

park-country.description: Given the name of a park or nature reserve, give the country where it is located.

product-company.description: Given the name of a product, give the company that makes it.

next_item.description: Given an item of a familiar sequence (a number written as a word or in digits, a letter, a Roman numeral, a day of the week or a month), give the item that comes right after it.

prev_item.description: Given an item of a familiar sequence (a number written as a word or in digits, a letter, a Roman numeral, a day of the week or a month), give the item that comes right before it.

english-french.description: Given an English word, give its translation into French.

english-german.description: Given an English word, give its translation into German.

english-spanish.description: Given an English word, give its translation into Spanish.
